deprecation.merged_value_semantics: delta.sum() - delta[argmax(abs(delta))] on the exact-common issue set (paired-delta sensitivity), not armwise ex-largest
deprecation.statement: The merged #394 field `matched_ex_largest_lift_cny` is DEPRECATED and MUST NOT be consumed as an armwise ex-largest lift. It was computed as the paired-delta sensitivity `delta.sum() - delta[argmax(abs(delta))]` on the exact-common issue set, not as an armwise ex-largest removal. Consumers must use `armwise_ex_largest_lift_cny` for armwise ex-largest semantics and `largest_absolute_paired_delta_sensitivity_cny` for the paired-delta sensitivity semantics.
